description: LOCAL-ONLY TOOL (this Pedra MCP server runs on the user's own computer, so it can read files from its disk). Upload 360° photo files (2:1 equirectangular JPEG, PNG or WebP) from absolute local paths into a property, in the order given — that order becomes the walking order when you then call pedra_create_virtual_tour with just the propertyId. Files are sent in batches (10 per call, under the 50 MB request limit); a file over ~33 MB can't be sent this way — use pedra_create_upload_link for those. Prefer this over pedra_create_upload_link whenever the 360° photos are files on this computer. Returns the added photos (imageIds are scene ids) and any that failed, each with its path.

paths.description: Absolute paths to 360° photo files on this computer, in walking order (file:// URLs and ~ are accepted).

propertyId.description: Target property id (from pedra_list_properties or pedra_create_property).

name: pedra_add_local_panoramas
title: Add local 360° photos to property
